mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by at least 1.0% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a rising consumer price index signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 persons over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a severe supply-side shock and weak demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% per annum, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
